announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~53%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp still #1 at 11.9%) and Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (13%) and still S-tier for top-8 conversion on Spellslinger (65 top 8s in 30 days), -17 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 11.2% to 6.0% and only C-tier, Rakdos Delirium now the most played deck at 6.8% and S-tier, winning the Nov 11 and Nov 12 Challenges; effective archetypes steady near 32; no new WotC wording as of Nov 15). Goldfish and Spellslinger disagree on the trend, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Emrakul, the Promised End or Blade of the Bloodchief are the narrower enablers and the consensus pick; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 20% of all Modern decks, which WotC avoids hitting.
#43 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 15 there is no new WotC word; the deck is still the most played on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp 11.9%) and MTGTop8 (Broodscale Bloodchief 13%), but Rakdos Delirium has won back-to-back Challenges and leads Spellslinger's share, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is only slightly better than a coin flip. If WotC acts, Emrakul or Blade of the Bloodchief is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 588 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 13%, Rakdos Aggro 11%, UW Control 9%, Amulet Titan 7%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.9% (down from 12.2%); Eldrazi-family decks ~20% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.5%, Eldrazi 2.7%, Broodscale 1.2%+0.2%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.4%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #14 staple, 20% of decks; Sowing Mycospawn #31 (16%), Emrakul #36 (15%), Basking Broodscale #48 (12%), Blade of the Bloodchief #49 (12%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #43 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 12)
sources.takeaway: 53 players, won by Rakdos Delirium (no Command); only one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 3-4th.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 11)
sources.takeaway: 54 players, won by Living End; three Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, all at 5-8th.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 11, 70 players)
sources.takeaway: 70 players, won by Rakdos Delirium; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 3-4th.

sources.title: Eldrazi Ramp (Mono-Green Eldrazi Broodscale)
sources.takeaway: Goldfish's Eldrazi Ramp is the Broodscale combo deck: 4 Kozilek's Command, 4 Eldrazi Temple, 4 Mycospawn, ~4 Emrakul in every list.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
